modelingNotes: S1 p.32 identifies the exact order as OESAZX167, a mechanical sleeve for joining shafts or a coupling mechanism; shaft size 6 mm, mass 0.03 kg.
Source historical description gives 5...6 mm diameter; ABB evidence establishes 6 mm shaft size only. No 5 mm suitability or round-shaft geometry is asserted.
Zero electrical terminals, functions and fixed electrical links. Fastening screws and shaft interfaces are mechanical; no PE/bond terminal or electrical rating is inferred.
S2 ABB / Thomas & Betts sheet uses OESA-ZX167 for the same exact order. Accessory documentation view; associated switch and optional accessories are separate components.

connectionCoverage.notes: Mechanical shaft coupler only. No electrical connections, optional contacts or factory electrical links; surrounding equipment bonding is outside this accessory inventory.
